headline: The Golf Committee prepared for Special Town Meeting irrigation funding, while town committees advanced 2027 tricentennial plans and approved a septic variance.
synopsis: Ahead of Special Town Meeting, the Golf Committee finalized its advocacy strategy for an article extending and adding Community Preservation Act funds for golf course irrigation, while also voting to fund Audubon certification costs. The Tricentennial Committee executed a contract for a 200-drone light show to kick off Southborough's 300th anniversary in January 2027 and reviewed plans for an expanded summer music festival, parades, and fundraisers. The Board of Health approved a septic variance to allow a commercial-to-residential conversion at 66 Breakneck Hill Road and reviewed ongoing seasonal flu clinics.

highlights.title: Special Town Meeting golf irrigation funding strategy
highlights.why: The Golf Committee finalized its presentation plans for a warrant article requesting new and extended CPA funds alongside revolving funds for golf course irrigation, agreeing not to pursue floor amendments.

highlights.title: Contract signed for 2027 tricentennial drone light show
highlights.why: The committee executed a contract with Firefly for a 200-drone aerial light show on January 1, 2027, which will feature 20 formations including two designs from local middle school students.

highlights.title: Septic variance approved for 66 Breakneck Hill Road
highlights.why: The Board of Health voted unanimously to approve an 85-foot wetland setback variance with a nitrogen-reducing treatment tank to support converting a commercial site into a four-bedroom home, contingent on Conservation Commission review.

highlights.title: Revolving funds approved for golf course Audubon certification
highlights.why: The committee voted to pay $500 in membership dues and authorize up to $4,500 from its revolving fund to cover a consultant bid to complete environmental certification.

highlights.title: Expansion of Summer Nights into 2027 music festival
highlights.why: Organizers advanced plans to expand the annual Summer Nights event into a full-day, multi-stage music festival on August 21, 2027, at Neary School grounds.

looking_ahead.what: Special Board of Health meeting to vote on the department budget
